text:
Amy (support): FYI a customer (AcmeCorp) reporting repeated 504s for hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate since 11:05 PST. They see timeouts after ~15-20s consistently.
Matt (oncall): @Amy can you paste request ids and example timestamps?
Amy (support): Sure — example request ids: rq_01H7XK0D8J, rq_01H7XK1Z9A. Received around 11:07 and 11:09 PST. Customer provided curl: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"summarize..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Lisa (CS): Customer says this started after they increased concurrency from 4 -> 16 last night. They also saw billing spikes.
Jamal (sre): Pinging edge metrics — I see backend latency climb and then a small surge of 502/504 at 11:06-11:12. Host pool for eu-west-1 had elevated queue depth. Could be autoscaler slowness + burst.
Matt (oncall): Any auth/billing errors in logs?
Oliver (billing): No billing infra errors on our side. There are a few mismatched invoice events but unrelated. Client tokens validate fine.
Julia (eng): Can you capture gateway logs for the request ids? Also check KV-cache hit rates; if prefix caching missed it could cause full model runs and queue pressure.
Amy (support): Pasted gateway snippet: 
```
[11:07:12] proxy: incoming rq= rq_01H7XK0D8J route=/v1/generate conn=10.2.3.45
[11:07:12] auth: token ok user=acme-team
[11:07:29] backend: enqueue rq= rq_01H7XK0D8J -> pool=dedicated-gpu-pool-3 queue_len=18
[11:07:32] backend: response 504 rq= rq_01H7XK0D8J cause=slot_timeout
```
Jamal (sre): queue_len=18 is concerning — autoscaler should add capacity at ~12. Looks like scale-up didn't trigger; investigating scaler logs.
Matt (oncall): @ops-bot can you surface recent autoscaler events for dedicated-gpu-pool-3?
ops-bot: autoscaler events for dedicated-gpu-pool-3: 
- 10:50 scale up to 8 nodes
- 11:01 scale up request queued (reason: quota-check)
- 11:06 scale up failed (reason: node-quota-limit)
- 11:20 automated fallback to burst-queue applied
Jamal (sre): Node quota limit explains delay — pool couldn't grow, queue built up, gateways timed out. Need immediate mitigation: route ACME traffic to a different pool or enable burst fallback earlier.
Julia (eng): Temporary workaround: update routing policy to route acme-team -> dedicated-gpu-pool-7 which has capacity. I can push a route change if authorized.
Matt (oncall): Do it. Keep rollback plan ready. Julia, tag me in the PR.
Julia (eng): Pushed route change to canary for acme-team; rolling to 2% now.
Amy (support): Customer confirmed one successful request at 11:25 (after canary). They're seeing improvement. :thumbsup:
Oliver (billing): Note: rerouting might increase unit cost for them; flagging for CS to communicate.
Lisa (CS): I'll notify customer and advise on concurrency best practices + cost implications.
Jamal (sre): Root cause so far: node quota prevented autoscaler growth leading to prolonged queueing and gateway timeouts (504).
Matt (oncall): Next steps (action items):
- Julia: create infra ticket to request higher node quota for eu-west-1 and add quota monitoring alert (owner: eng-infra).
- Jamal: add autoscaler failure metrics to critical dashboards and an alert when scale-up fails due to quota.
- Amy/Lisa: confirm customer impact window and send post-incident note.
- Oliver: review billing spike with CS and create cost-advisory doc for re-routed traffic.
- Matt: update runbook to include immediate fallback to non-constrained pools when scale-up fails.
Amy (support): Assigning owners in ops tracker now.
Julia (eng): Filed infra request INF-1298 (increase node quota) and created PR for runbook update.
Jamal (sre): Will follow up with dashboard patch.
Lisa (CS): Sending customer summary now.
Matt (oncall): Closing warroom — monitor for 1hr then update postmortem. Add postmortem owners and link evals for possible model/sequence-length causes.
Amy (support): Postmortem owners: Matt, Jamal, Julia. I'll create the initial postmortem doc and link logs + repro steps.
Julia (eng): Repro steps we captured (for postmortem):
1) Synthetic client: 16 concurrent streams using same token
2) Payloads with avg seq_len ~1200 tokens
3) Run for 10 minutes to hit queueing
Commands: 
```bash
ab -n 1000 -c 16 -p payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Matt (oncall): Good. We'll include recommended limits and autoscaler hardening in postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Amy (support): Thanks everyone. I'll attach the customer communication and timeline to the postmortem doc.
